description_en: Detaches instance RAM roles from one or more ECS instances
description_zh: 本接口用于收回一台或多台ECS实例被授予的RAM角色
kebab_example: aliyun ecs detach-instance-ram-role --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-ram-role-name RamRoleTest --instance-ids 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_i-bp67acfmxazb5p0000_,_i-bp67acfmxazb6p0000_…' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachInstanceRamRole

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The name of the instance RAM role to detach. You can call the RAM API [ListRoles](~~28713~~) to query the names of instance RAM roles that you have created.
parameters.description_zh: 指定收回的实例RAM角色名称。您可以使用RAM API [ListRoles](~~28713~~)查询您已创建的实例RAM角色名称。
parameters.help_en: The name of the instance RAM role to detach. You can call the RAM API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html to query the names of instance RAM roles that you have created
parameters.help_zh: 指定收回的实例RAM角色名称。您可以使用RAM API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html查询您已创建的实例RAM角色名称
parameters.name: ram_role_name

parameters.description_en: The instance IDs of the instances from which to detach the RAM role. Array length: 1 to 100.
parameters.description_zh: 指定收回的实例ID数组。数组长度：1~100。
parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the instances from which to detach the RAM role. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定收回的实例ID数组。数组长度：1~100
parameters.name: instance_ids
